Contract SearchBook::searchBookByTitle(title: String): Set(Book) {
	definition:
		books: Set(Book) = Book.allInstance()->select(b|b.Title = title)
	precondition:
		title.oclIsUndefined() = bool and
		books.isEmpty() = bool
	postcondition:
		let ob: Book in
		ob.oclIsNew() and
		Book.allInstance()->includes(ob) and
		result = books
}
